boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten named academic environments on MCCN’s Columbus campus. Confirm room availability and any day-of access requirements before settling in.

cards.title: Health Sciences Library: Third Floor
cards.subtitle: Center for Learning and Education, third floor
cards.notes: Bring research questions and work near the College’s Health Sciences Library. Check current library access and service details before arriving.
cards.short_summary: A library-floor option in the Center for Learning and Education.
cards.evidence_claim: MCCN lists the Health Sciences Library on the third floor of the Center for Learning and Education.
cards.access_notes: Campus facility; verify current library entry and service access with MCCN or the library.

cards.title: Health Sciences Library: Fourth Floor
cards.subtitle: Center for Learning and Education, fourth floor
cards.notes: Use the fourth-floor library area for individual reading or coursework, then ask library staff about the current use of nearby rooms.
cards.short_summary: The library’s upper floor sits beside designated student study rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: MCCN lists the Health Sciences Library and student study rooms on the fourth floor of the Center for Learning and Education.
cards.access_notes: Campus facility; verify current library entry and service access with MCCN or the library.

cards.title: Fourth-Floor Library Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Mount Carmel Health Sciences Library, fourth floor
cards.notes: Reserve a fourth-floor study room when a contained setting suits your work. Confirm capacity, reservation instructions, and availability first.
cards.short_summary: Reservable individual-or-group rooms in the Health Sciences Library.
cards.evidence_claim: Mount Carmel Health Sciences Library states that three fourth-floor study rooms accommodate four to eight people and may be reserved for individual or group study.
cards.source_title: MCCN Faculty | Mount Carmel Health Sciences Library
cards.access_notes: The library says the rooms can be reserved for individual or group study; confirm availability and reservation process before use.

cards.title: Prayer and Quiet Meditation Room
cards.subtitle: Mount Carmel Health Sciences Library, fourth floor
cards.notes: For a brief quiet reading or reset between coursework, locate the designated prayer and quiet-meditation room on the library’s fourth floor.
cards.short_summary: A designated quiet room within the fourth-floor library area.
cards.evidence_claim: Mount Carmel Health Sciences Library identifies a fourth-floor room designated for prayer and quiet meditation.
cards.source_title: MCCN Faculty | Mount Carmel Health Sciences Library
cards.access_notes: Use respectfully for its stated purpose; confirm current access and applicable room expectations with library staff.

cards.title: Computer Lab
cards.subtitle: Center for Learning and Education, second floor
cards.notes: Plan computer-based coursework in the CLE Computer Lab, and check with the College for current open-lab times or class scheduling.
cards.short_summary: A named campus lab for work that requires a computer station.
cards.evidence_claim: MCCN lists a Computer Lab on the second floor of the Center for Learning and Education.
cards.access_notes: Availability may be affected by instructional use; verify current access with MCCN before planning a session.

cards.title: Student Success Center
cards.subtitle: Center for Learning and Education, second floor
cards.notes: Use this academic-support destination as a checkpoint for coursework planning, then confirm current services or appointment procedures before visiting.
cards.short_summary: A named student-support location in the Center for Learning and Education.
cards.evidence_claim: MCCN lists the Student Success Center on the second floor of the Center for Learning and Education.
cards.access_notes: Confirm current services, appointment requirements, and access with MCCN before visiting.

cards.title: Classroom 310
cards.subtitle: Center for Learning and Education, third floor
cards.notes: If an instructor or College office confirms it is available, use Classroom 310 as a course-adjacent setting for focused academic work.
cards.short_summary: A specifically numbered classroom on the library floor of the CLE.
cards.evidence_claim: MCCN lists Classroom 310 on the third floor of the Center for Learning and Education.
cards.access_notes: This is a classroom, not confirmed open study space; use only with MCCN or instructor approval.

cards.title: Lecture Hall 103
cards.subtitle: Center for Learning and Education, first floor
cards.notes: Consider this named lecture hall only when it is formally available for academic use; confirm event or course scheduling before relying on it.
cards.short_summary: A numbered lecture hall in the Center for Learning and Education.
cards.evidence_claim: MCCN lists Lecture Hall 103 on the first floor of the Center for Learning and Education.
cards.access_notes: This is a lecture hall, not confirmed open study space; use only with MCCN or instructor approval.

cards.title: Classroom 206
cards.subtitle: Center for Learning and Education, second floor
cards.notes: Use this specifically listed classroom for independent academic work only if the College confirms it is not scheduled for instruction or events.
cards.evidence_claim: MCCN lists Classroom 206 on the second floor of the Center for Learning and Education.
cards.access_notes: This is a classroom, not confirmed open study space; use only with MCCN or instructor approval.

cards.title: Student Lounge and Rec Room
cards.subtitle: Marian Hall, first floor
cards.notes: Choose the Student Lounge and Rec Room for a change of setting, then keep your session considerate of others using its recreation amenities.
cards.short_summary: A named student common area in Marian Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: MCCN lists the Student Lounge and Rec Room on the first floor of Marian Hall.
cards.access_notes: Campus student area; confirm current building entry and any space-use expectations with MCCN.

warnings: Several listed classrooms and the lecture hall are instructional spaces rather than confirmed open study areas; each card flags that approval and availability must be verified.
